$comment: Line-coverage floor for openaudible-autoupdate.sh under the bats unit tests (tests/unit), measured with kcov 43 in registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:latest (see 'Coverage' in README.md). Enforced by scripts/coverage-gate.mjs via .github/workflows/coverage-gate.yml. kcov reports line coverage only for Bash. 'measured' was 45/45 lines on the commit that introduced this file; 'floor' sits 5 points below so a newly added, untested branch of a few lines fails but ordinary churn passes. Floors only go up. Raising a floor makes the check catch more, so it is the 'Adding or widening a check' case in AGENTS.md's owner's standing decisions: an agent may raise one without asking. Lowering a floor, or exempting anything from it, needs the owner.
